questions.question_text: What is the built-in role that grants read-only access to all resources in a subscription?
questions.explanation: The Reader role provides read‑only permissions across the entire subscription.

questions.question_text: Which built-in role allows management of access to Azure resources but not to the subscription itself?
questions.explanation: User Access Administrator can assign roles to users and groups but cannot modify subscription settings.

questions.question_text: How do you assign a custom role to a resource group?

options.label: A
options.text: Through Azure portal > Access control (IAM) > Add role assignment > select custom role > assign to resource group

options.label: B
options.text: Via Azure CLI using az role assignment create with --assignee and --role

options.label: C
options.text: By editing the resource group's ARM template

questions.explanation: In the portal you navigate to the resource group’s IAM, click Add role assignment, choose the custom role, and assign it to the resource group.

questions.question_text: Which PowerShell cmdlet is used to assign a role at the subscription scope?
questions.explanation: New‑AzRoleAssignment creates a role assignment at the specified scope (subscription, resource group, or resource).

questions.question_text: If a user has the 'User Access Administrator' role, what can they do that the 'Contributor' role cannot?
questions.explanation: User Access Administrator can assign roles; Contributor cannot perform role assignments.

questions.question_text: What does the 'Effective permissions' blade show?

options.label: A
options.text: Only the permissions of the selected role

options.label: B
options.text: Permissions after considering all role assignments and inheritance

options.label: C
options.text: The permissions of the user's Azure AD account only

options.label: D
options.text: The permissions of the resource provider

questions.explanation: Effective permissions combine the user's role assignments, inheritance, and any denied permissions to show the final rights.

questions.question_text: Which scenario illustrates an inherited role assignment?

options.label: A
options.text: Assigning a role at the subscription level and having it apply to all resource groups

options.label: B
options.text: Assigning a role directly to a resource

questions.explanation: A role assigned at the subscription level cascades down to all child scopes, providing inheritance.

questions.question_text: How can you verify which roles are assigned to a specific user?

options.label: A
options.text: Azure portal > Users > select user > View assigned roles

options.label: B
options.text: Azure CLI: az role assignment list --assignee <userId>

questions.explanation: The az role assignment list command filters by the assignee to show all role assignments for that user.

questions.question_text: What is the difference between 'AssignableScopes' of a built-in role and a custom role?

options.label: A
options.text: AssignableScopes defines where the role can be assigned; built‑in roles have fixed scopes, custom roles can define assignable scopes.

options.label: B
options.text: Only custom roles have AssignableScopes; built‑in roles do not have this property.

options.label: C
options.text: AssignableScopes are used only for resource‑level assignments.

options.label: D
options.text: There is no difference between built‑in and custom roles regarding AssignableScopes.

questions.explanation: AssignableScopes determines the scope levels at which a role can be assigned; built‑in roles have predefined scopes while custom roles can specify their own assignable scopes.

questions.question_text: When interpreting role assignments, which of the following is true?

options.label: A
options.text: A role assignment can be scoped to a management group, subscription, resource group, or resource

options.label: B
options.text: Role assignments are only effective at the resource level

options.label: C
options.text: A user can have multiple role assignments that conflict, but the most restrictive applies

options.label: D
options.text: Role assignments are immutable once created

questions.explanation: Role assignments can be applied at various scopes—management group, subscription, resource group, or individual resource.
